list.name: Changes
list.comment: feat: update media URL to use HTTP instead of HTTPS and remove unnecessary htaccess modification logic in AdminHooks.php

task.summary: fix: update title for domain registration in AdminHooks.php

feat: add daily backup feature to Nixfile Uploader plugin
- Implemented daily backup functionality with scheduling via WP Cron. - Added a button in the admin UI for users to enable/disable daily backups. - Updated REST API routes to handle daily backup settings. - Enhanced user notifications for immediate backups triggered upon enabling the feature.

fix: update API URL to use dynamic host and improve code consistency
- Changed the API URL in `apiRoutes.js` to utilize the dynamic `nixfile_ajax_data.url`. - Refactored various instances in `AdminHooks.php` to ensure consistent formatting and coding standards, including method definitions and action filters.

feat(htaccess): add dynamic rewrite rule for media subdomain redirection on install
- Introduced a method to modify the .htaccess file to include a rewrite rule for redirecting media subdomain requests to api.nixfile.com. - Ensured the rule is added only if it doesn't already exist and handled the case where the .htaccess file is not writable. - Updated instances of home_url parsing to maintain consistency.

feat: refactor dynamic site URL generation and rewrite block for media redirection
- Improved the clarity of comments related to the site URL generation. - Refactored the rewrite rule construction to use a dedicated block format. - Added checks to ensure existing rules are not duplicated in the .htaccess file. - Updated error handling for .htaccess file accessibility.

fix: update redirect rules and cleanup in AdminHooks.php
- Removed commented-out legacy redirect code. - Added dynamic redirect for media domain to api.nixfile.com. - Improved code readability and organization.
feat: update media URL to use HTTP instead of HTTPS and remove unnecessary htaccess modification logic in AdminHooks.php
